requirements. * Keen interest in design trends, creativity, and emerging technologies, and their impact on design solutions. **The Offer** * Full-time, permanent role based in Co. Our graduate programme is all about learning new and developing your existing skills. Over a two-year period, you will be placed in projects where you get to do meaningful work and contribute to the business. If successful, you will enjoy NeoDyne's "People First" company culture, built on mutual respect, trust, and honesty, where each individual actively contributes as a valued team member. **What might I be doing?** * Over a two-year period, you will be placed in projects where you get to do meaningful work and contribute to the business. Don't miss this opportunity to join a company at the forefront of industrial automation projects in Ireland, the UK, mainland Europe and the US. So why wait? Apply Today! NeoDyne Ltd. is an equal opportunity employer, and all applications will be treated in strictest confidence.

workflow automations that improve business processes and reduce manual activity. * Build and maintain APIs and integrations that enable AI models to interact securely with enterprise applications, data sources and business systems. * Develop production-quality solutions using technologies such as Python and Rust, with exposure to TypeScript and Node.js where appropriate. * Support the development of AI agent workflows, including prompt design, tool use, orchestration, evaluation and appropriate technical safeguards. * Work with Microsoft technologies including Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform, Dataverse and Microsoft Graph to develop integrated automation solutions. * Use Git and GitHub for source control, branching, pull requests, code reviews, CI/CD processes and general development collaboration. * Produce clear technical documentation, including architecture notes, support documentation, implementation guidance and operational procedures. * Engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand requirements, demonstrate solutions and refine applications based on user feedback. **Experience Required** * 1-3 years’ professional experience in software engineering, AI engineering, automation or a related technical area, with strong graduate, academic, personal or open-source projects also considered. * Practical experience developing solutions using generative AI models and associated APIs rather than solely using consumer chat interfaces. * Good understanding of AI concepts including prompting, context management, function or tool calling and the limitations of large language models. * Working knowledge of Rust, ideally demonstrated through an academic, personal or open-source project, together with an understanding of concepts such as ownership, error handling and dependency management. * Strong Python fundamentals and familiarity with modern Python project, environment and dependency management tools. * Experience building or consuming REST APIs, including working with JSON, authentication mechanisms, error handling and API documentation. * Good understanding of core software engineering practices including testing, debugging, maintainable code and version control. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to colleagues from non-technical backgrounds. **Desirable Skills** * Exposure to Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI agents or frameworks supporting multi-step tool use and workflow orchestration. * Knowledge of Microsoft technologies such as Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, Dataverse, SharePoint Online, Microsoft Graph or Microsoft Copilot. * TypeScript and Node.js development experience. * Understanding of SQL, document processing, vector databases, semantic search or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). * Exposure to Azure services such as Functions, App Service, Key Vault or Storage. * Familiarity with Docker, cloud deployment practices and CI/CD pipelines. * Experience evaluating AI applications, including logging, tracing, output quality measurement, reliability and cost monitoring. * Awareness of data protection, confidentiality, responsible AI and regulatory considerations when developing AI-enabled systems. * Understanding of secure software development practices including secrets management, least-privilege access, prompt-injection risks and prevention of unintended data exposure. * Experience with workflow automation or low-code platforms would be beneficial. **Educational Requirements** * Third-level degree or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence or another related discipline. * Candidates with a strong demonstrable portfolio of equivalent technical work may also be considered. **Working Hours & Benefits** * Permanent position with standard Monday-to-Friday working hours. * Opportunity to join a developing AI and automation capability at an early stage. * Broad exposure to AI engineering, software development, APIs, cloud technologies and enterprise automation. * Opportunity to work directly with experienced technology leadership and contribute to engineering standards and ways of working. * Continued professional development in a rapidly evolving area of technology. * Exposure to a range of modern AI models, platforms and development tools. **How to Apply** To apply for this role, please submit your updated CV. If your skills and experience match job requirements, you will be contacted to discuss your application in detail. **Similar Roles Open** As a specialised recruitment agency, we also have several other permanent and contract IT roles available. Visit our website for more information or explore additional opportunities.

title: Graduate Programme, Audit - Dublin (Sept 2027)
description: **Job Description** **Why Start Your Career at S&W?** Starting your career is about more than just a job. It's about the people you learn from, the relationships you build and the experiences that shape you. Whether that's passing an exam, achieving a personal milestone or celebrating success with your colleagues, you'll be part of a team that's invested in your growth, celebrates your successes and supports you to be yourself. At S&W, you'll be given meaningful work from day one, while having the support, training and encouragement to help you succeed. You'll learn by doing, working alongside experienced colleagues, contributing to real projects and developing valuable professional skills from the start. As your confidence grows, so will your opportunities, with plenty of support along the way. As a growing accountancy and advisory firm, we offer a balance of opportunity and support. You'll learn from people at every level of the business, gain exposure to a variety of clients, industries and experiences, and develop the skills, knowledge and confidence needed to build a successful career. **The Audit & Assurance Team at S&W** Our Audit & Assurance team works with a diverse range of clients, from entrepreneurial and family-owned businesses to charities, not-for-profit organisations and larger established businesses across a variety of industries. What sets Audit & Assurance at S&W apart is the breadth of experience you'll gain early in your career. You'll develop technical expertise, commercial awareness and a well-rounded understanding of how organisations operate, while working closely with experienced colleagues and gaining exposure to senior leaders and Partners. Together, this provides a strong foundation for a successful career in the profession. **What Will You Be Doing?** As part of our Audit & Assurance team, you'll work alongside colleagues to deliver services to a variety of clients. You'll be involved in different stages of an engagement, gaining insight into how organisations operate and the role assurance plays in building confidence in financial reporting. Alongside your role, you'll study towards the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) or Chartered Accountants Ireland (CAI) qualification. Through a combination of professional training and practical experience, you'll build a strong foundation in audit, accountancy and wider business advisory services. You'll be supported with funded training, dedicated study time and guidance from colleagues who have successfully completed the qualification themselves. Your work will include: * Analysing financial information * Testing processes and controls * Building relationships with client teams * Resolving audit and accountancy queries * Supporting a range of audit and accountancy projects Whether you're based in one of our offices or working directly with clients, you'll contribute to meaningful work from day one while building the skills and confidence needed to become a trusted adviser. **To Be Successful in This Role** You'll be someone who: * Is curious, eager to learn and open to new challenges * Enjoys working with others and building positive relationships * Has a keen eye for detail and enjoys solving problems * Is proactive and looks for ways to make a positive contribution * Takes ownership of their development and is motivated to achieve their goals You'll also need to: * Be committed to working towards the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) or Chartered Accountants Ireland (CAI) qualification * Have some accountancy experience, as part of your education or work experience * Have obtained or be predicted a minimum 2:2 degree, in any discipline * Minimum 400 Leaving Certificate points (or equivalent) * Leaving Certificate O2 or H5 in Maths and English (or equivalent) **Your Learning & Development** We'll support you throughout your qualification journey with a leading UK training provider, dedicated study time and practical experience that complements your learning. You'll join as part of a cohort and benefit from a support network that includes experienced colleagues, a buddy and our Learning & Development team, helping you make the most of the opportunities available to you. **As a Colleague at S&W, You'll Have Access to Benefits That Include** * Fully funded training towards professional qualifications * Competitive salary * Private medical insurance * Life assurance * Pension contribution * Generous holiday package * Option to purchase additional holiday * Cycle to work scheme * Season ticket loan * Eye care support * Shared parental leave **Our Commitment to Inclusion** We are proud to value the differences that a diverse workforce brings, representative of society and our clients. At S&W we have a wide range of highly active employee resource groups and we’re delivering multiple diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives across the organisation. It is our commitment to provide a workspace where all colleagues, regardless of identity, background, or circumstance, feel respected as individuals and feel that they can achieve their full potential and work in a safe, supportive, and inclusive environment. We are happy to make any reasonable adjustments to accommodate for your needs throughout the application process. Please let your Recruiter know. **IMPORTANT NOTES FOR COMPLETING YOUR APPLICATION** When you click on the **'I'm interested'** button, you'll be taken to your profile page. We're currently updating it, but in the meantime: * We can only accept one application to any of our programmes in a recruitment season. If you're unsuccessful, you'll need to wait until the following recruitment season to reapply. * Under the **Resume (CV)** section, uploading a document is mandatory; however, it will not be formally reviewed.
